welcome.title: Welcome to EMDAD!
welcome.description: Let us give you a quick tour of the system. This will only take a moment.
welcome.langHint: You can switch the language using the button below.

sidebar.title: Navigation Menu
sidebar.description: Access all system features from the sidebar. It organizes everything into clear sections for easy navigation.

dashboard.title: Dashboard Overview
dashboard.description: Your central hub for monitoring all requests. View statuses, track progress, and stay on top of operations at a glance.

requestManagement.title: Request Management
requestManagement.description: Create and manage requests from here. You can issue new requests, submit returns, or initiate discards.

approvalManagement.title: Approval Management
approvalManagement.description: Review and manage approval workflows for all requests. Track request statuses, approve or reject pending items, and open detailed request reports.

theme.title: Theme Toggle
theme.description: Switch between light and dark mode to suit your preference.

language.title: Language
language.description: Switch between English and Arabic. The entire interface will update instantly.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Stay informed with real-time notifications about request updates, approvals, and important alerts.

profile.title: Your Profile
profile.description: Access your profile settings, manage delegations, and sign out from here.

complete.title: You're All Set!
complete.description: You now know the essentials. You can replay this tour anytime from your profile page.

onboarding.replayDescription: Take the guided tour again to review system features

intro.title: Issue New Request
intro.description: Create an issue request in five steps: choose your allowance, select items and quantities, enter usage details, review everything, then submit. The stepper shows where you are in the process.

stepper.title: Request Steps
stepper.description:
1. Allowance Selection – Choose regular or reserve allowance
2. Selection – Pick items and quantities
3. Usage – Specify purpose, location, and dates
4. Review – Verify all details before submitting
5. Send – Submit and receive confirmation

intro.title: Return Request
intro.description: Use this page to submit a return request for previously issued items.

tabs.title: Item Type Tabs
tabs.description: Select the category of items you want to return: Ammunition, Weapons, or Explosives. Each tab shows the relevant form for that item type.

intro.title: Discard Request
intro.description: Use this page to submit a discard request for items that need to be disposed of.

tabs.title: Item Type Tabs
tabs.description: Select the category of items to discard: Ammunition, Weapons, or Explosives. Each tab shows the relevant form for that item type.

intro.title: Add New Asset
intro.description: Use this page to register a new asset into the system. Select the asset type and fill in the required details.

tabs.title: Asset Type Tabs
tabs.description: Choose the type of asset you want to add: Ammunition, Explosive, or Weapon. Each tab shows the specific form fields for that asset type.

intro.title: Asset List
intro.description: Browse and manage all registered assets. You can view, edit, delete, and filter assets from this page.

header.title: Tabs & Actions
header.description: Switch between Ammunition, Explosives, and Weapons tabs to view each category. Use the Add button to register a new asset.

filters.title: Filters & Search
filters.description: Narrow down the list using filters and the search bar. You can filter by various attributes and clear them at any time.
